parts.title: Part 3 · Dictation
parts.instr: Your teacher reads the dictation. Write what you hear in the box.
chunks: It's almost like he's whispering sometimes!
A war journalist needs to be
it would leave a terrible stain
I'm keen to sell this fruit
and we've got tons of it left.

parts.text: There will be little sorrow at the king's departure. Am I going deaf or is our teacher quiet? It's almost like he's whispering sometimes! A war journalist needs to be both curious and courageous. Whatever you do, don't spill that ink; it would leave a terrible stain on the carpet. I'm keen to sell this fruit as quickly as possible. It's already looking a bit overripe, and we've got tons of it left. The actual concert venue doesn't open till eight, so, meanwhile, why don't we enjoy the warmth of that bar?
